units.source_text: 转眼之间，一群比蚊子还小的飞虫，落在她那从空开的后领露出来的、抹了浓重白粉的脖颈上。

en.t: In the blink of an eye, a swarm of tiny flying insects, smaller than mosquitoes, settled on the thickly powdered white nape of her neck, exposed through the open back of her collar.

units.source_text: 有的虫子眼看着就死去，在那儿一动不动了。

en.t: Some of the insects died before her eyes and lay there without moving.
